initialization: Public pose-reaching: cold repeated actual rest state and zero controls; then bsqp.common shift of previous output reanchored at actual state. Reset dual and rho once per episode; retain adaptive rho and duals across feedback solves. First t0 solve supplies first executed prefix and is recorded.
comparison: Research multistart receding-horizon MPC versus a nominal16x SQP allowance on one actual plant. Reuse B1cap1000 OFF_TORQUE baseline; newB1cap16000 andB16cap1000 only. All other costs/gates/timing/source/inputs unchanged. Not independent lane plants, public force-hypothesis selection, exact equal realized compute or a parallel-throughput experiment.

limit_penalty.core_change: Reviewed C2 quadratic continuation plus explicit interior cost bounds at all value/gradient/Hessian callsites; raw limits, dynamics and controller unchanged.

cost_bounds.initial_states: Unchanged, including those outside interior cost bounds; no clipping or filtering.

orientation_scale_motivation: Original running/terminal orientation-to-position weight ratios both .025: a 1rad weighted RPY error-norm is equivalent in quadratic cost to about158mm Cartesian position error. LOW ratio .0025 gives about50mm per1rad (100mm per2rad); OFF removes the orientation-goal cost, leaving positional IK redundancy. These are cost equivalents for wrapped RPY components, not physical rotation angles or success guarantees.
torque_scale_motivation: The ordinary torque quadratic coefficient falls10x, while the torque barrier stays fixed. Zero-torque barrier curvature is2*ctrl_lim_cost/U_cost^2:2.994e-5 for joints1/2,8.190e-5 for3..7 cost/Nm^2. Total zero-torque curvature changes from1.2994e-4/1.8190e-4 to3.994e-5/9.190e-5, reductions about3.25x/1.98x. Curvature at nonzero gravity torque is larger; this is not a uniform10x total-cost reduction or a predicted motion outcome.
pilot_selection: Three scientifically selected OFF_TORQUE timeout cases plus one known quick arrival; frozen before either new arm is measured.
cold_policy: First solve uses identical repeated actual rest state and zero controls in every lane; this first solve is recorded and applied, with no excluded warmup.
proposal_policy: One cold actual-rest/zero-control seed; thereafter only shifted previous selected plan reanchored at actual state. B1 receives no perturbations and consumes no proposal RNG draws.
rng_policy: numpy.default_rng(SeedSequence([20260925,pair_id,30000])); canonical pair_id0. Save bit-generator name plus every drawn coefficient/amplitude and every candidate seed.
selection_policy: Finite complete optimized plan, finite native final_merit, finite full30ms RK4 prefix from sameactualstate. Minimum(final_merit,lane). Raw physical bounds diagnostic only, never veto. No extra native sim_forward/residual instrumentation.
persistent_state_policy: Reset dual and rho once per episode, retain adaptive rho/duals per native slot across feedback including fresh proposals; no winner copying/permutation of dual or rho. Deliberate difference from historicalBA reset-rho-each-solve.
native_stopping: Unchanged source85 solve_ratio1: current all-lane zero-PCG/residual condition stops batch; individual zero lane may update while others continue. Never force continuation past native exit. Record selected/alllane work separately.
diagnostic_stage_policy: Record exact canonical outcome first with original gates. This newly requested diagnostic study retains scientific task/physical negatives without relabeling; explicit root launch receipt authorizes pilot. Shared setup/import/module/GPU-access failure holds dependent work; individual case failures retained and remaining independent cases continue; no retries.
nominal_compute: B1cap16000 is16times B1cap1000 allowance and equals16x1000 nominal lane allowance only. Natural stopping/PCG work, timing and behavior remain measured/descriptive, not exactly equal compute.
